claims.evidence: Every sampled raw header (12 files, all 7 acquisition dates) decodes 'Q Exactive' (no Plus/HF). Paper LC-MS/MS: 'connected online to a Q Exactive instrument'. The LTQ-Velos runs mentioned in the paper (cell-line set-up) are not deposited.
Paper: 'The Q Exactive instrument was operated in the data-dependent acquisition (DDA) mode'; top-5.

Paper Histone Digestion: in-gel digestion 'with 100 ng/ul trypsin (Promega)' after D6-acetic anhydride derivatisation, giving an 'Arg-C like' digestion. MaxQuant search rule was Protease=Arg-C (summary.txt), recorded here as a note only; campaign rule 2: cleavage agent = digestion enzyme.
Paper: 'fragmented by HCD with a normalized collision energy setting of 25%'. MS:1000422 synonym HCD.
Paper: 'normalized collision energy setting of 25%'.
Paper: histones 'separated on a 17% SDS-PAGE gel and bands corresponding to histones H3 and H4 were excised and in-gel digested'. PRIDE:0000568 is a descendant of PRIDE:0000550 (OLS ancestors).
Paper/PRIDE data processing: 'The mass tolerance was set to 6 ppm for precursor and fragment ions' (MaxQuant 1.3.0.5 main-search tolerance; not written to parameters.txt in this version).
parameters.txt (all 17 jobs): 'MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm' - HCD spectra in the Orbitrap are FTMS. The paper's prose says 6 ppm for fragments; the deposited search parameters win.
Q Exactive acquires HCD MS/MS in the Orbitrap; MaxQuant applied the FTMS MS/MS tolerance.
Paper: 'Survey full scan MS spectra (m/z 300-1650)'.

limitations: techsdrf is not installed: instrument checked by HTTP range-read of 12 raw headers only (one or more per acquisition date), not by full-file parsing; scan settings come from the paper.

Precursor tolerance 6 ppm is from paper prose (MaxQuant 1.3.0.5 parameters.txt does not record the main-search tolerance); fragment 20 ppm is from parameters.txt and contradicts the paper's '6 ppm for precursor and fragment ions'.

Search enzyme was Arg-C (MaxQuant) while the digestion reagent was trypsin after lysine D6-acetylation; comment[cleavage agent details] = Trypsin per campaign rule 2; sdrf-tools reconcile flags this (refuted in validation.txt). Reprocessing with an unrestricted trypsin rule would differ from the deposited Arg-C search.

The raw data were searched in 3-4 parallel MaxQuant jobs with different variable-modification subsets; comment[modification parameters] lists the union of the jobs each file went through, not one single search.
characteristics[preservation method] and characteristics[storage duration] are custom columns (no template column exists for FFPE vs frozen; spec 'Extending Templates').

Not deposited and therefore not annotated: the LTQ-Velos/Q Exactive super-SILAC set-up runs (five breast cancer lines + MCF10A spike-in, Fig S4), and the frozen LuA 6-10 / TN 6-10 samples (western blot only). PRIDE organismParts 'cell culture' and 'mammary gland epithelial cell' refer to that set-up work.

Patient age, sex, ancestry and treatment are not reported per patient anywhere in the deposit or paper (Table S3 / Fig S3A give subtype, ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67, grade/differentiation and pTNM only): 'not available'. 'Matched for other clinical features (age, sex, etc.)' is a cohort statement and was not copied onto rows.

Breast cancer subtypes were defined by IHC surrogates (St Gallen 2013, 'Luminal A-like' etc.); the NCIT terms used (Luminal A/B Breast Carcinoma, Triple-Negative, HER2-Positive) sit under 'Breast Carcinoma by Gene Expression Profile'. Closest available terms; the '-like' qualifier is lost.

Heavy reference rows: one source per spiked sample ('super-SILAC histone reference mix spiked into <sample>') because sdrf-tools build forbids one source with the same replicate/fraction across runs; all are aliquots of one mix ('mixed, aliquoted, lyophilized'). The SN= pooled-sample value triggers a parse_sdrf values-validator warning that contradicts the template's own pattern validator.

characteristics[clinical data] is free text built from Table S3 / Fig S3A cells (ER, PR, HER2 score, Ki-67, pTNM, differentiation); HER2 strings such as '80% (+)' are copied verbatim (1+ = HER2-negative by ASCO/CAP).
